summary: Indian boy from the state of Bihar who between 2006 and 2007, aged seven and eight, killed three babies: a cousin, his own sister and a neighbor six months old. He confessed to all three during interrogation, but due to his age was never tried as an adult: he went through a juvenile center from which he left upon reaching adulthood. The sources refer to him interchangeably as Amarjeet or Amardeep Sada and disagree on the age of the first victim.

murders.method: Beaten with a stone and buried.
